text:
alex_arch: RFC follow-up: proposing a lightweight per-tenant "handoff" proxy inside customer VPCs. single global CP, proxies do ENI/route programming, certs, and audit streaming. tradeoffs?

jena_infra: fewer peering links is nice. how do we avoid route table/API quota blast?

sam_net: aggregate prefixes behind one ENI per AZ or push forwarding to our regional relay and only program one handoff route in customer RTs.

rita_sre: operationally, ephemeral proxies add churn. require idempotent reconcile, async create/destroy, and clear metrics (boot_time, reconcile_lat, route_errors). fallback to relay if proxy unhealthy.

maya_product: customers want audit logs retained even if proxy torn down. proxies must stream encrypted events to customer-owned sinks and sign records we persist.

owen_sec: security: least-privilege cross-account role, allowlist subnets, short-lived certs. require customer opt-in and a CFN approval flow.

alex_arch: action items: 1) small spike: ENI+aggregated-route prototype, 2) 200-tenant API rate test, 3) draft IAM CFN snippet, 4) incident playbook for teardown races. follow-up Fri 11am.
